notes: No more endless 'thinking' after you send a mature photo. Reading your photo goes through your RunPod vision endpoint, and a GPU that has scaled to zero holds the request while it boots — the app used to wait on that forever with only a generic caption. The typing bubble now says what's happening ('reading your photo', then 'waking your GPU — cold start'), the wait is capped at 3 minutes for a cold start (60s for Z.ai, 60s of mid-reply silence), and a timeout tells you plainly to give the GPU a minute and resend instead of hanging the conversation.
